subject: Launch coverage accommodation request — BrightPath Q4 go-live
messages:
From: Emma Long <emma@brightpath.health>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath Commercial <commercial@brightpath.health>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood integration timeline — request for launch coverage

Hi Karthik,

Quick update from our side: the BrightPath integration team ran into a resource blocker for our patient-routing adapter. That pushes our pilot into early November instead of the end of October. Our board has tied the Redwood-powered feature to marketing commitments, so the delay is material for our Q4 plan.

We appreciate Redwood's work so far — performance numbers look good — but given the shift we need to discuss a commercial accommodation to bridge the launch gap (either a limited-rate waiver for the first 60 days or a credit against the Q4 invoice) so we can keep the customer pilot incentives intact.

Can you share what flexibility is available? We need to confirm terms by next Tuesday (Oct 6) to keep our dependent partners aligned. Attached is a short impact summary.

Thanks,
Emma

--
Emma Long
Head of Partnerships, BrightPath Health
emma@brightpath.health
[attachment: BrightPath_impact_summary.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Launch coverage accommodation request — BrightPath Q4 go-live

Laura / Monica — forwarding BrightPath's ask. Summary: pilot slipped ~4 weeks due to their adapter dev; they request either a rate waiver for first 60 days or a credit against Q4 to preserve their partner incentives. Impact: mid-sized account (~$120k ARR first year), strategic in payer segment, strong reference potential.

Key constraints:
- They need confirmation by Tue, Oct 6 to keep partner commitments.
- Proposed accommodation options from our side (initial thinking):
  1) 60-day 100% reduced per-token rate (i.e., trial-rate) applied to first invoice period; OR
  2) One-time credit of up to $12k applied to Q4 invoice (roughly 10% of expected Q4 spend) with a formal success milestone.

Attachments: I pulled BrightPath impact sheet and drafted a short term-sheet for the accommodation (see attached).

Ask: can we get an exec signoff (aditya) on one of these options or a counter? Also flagging that this will set a precedent — prefer timeboxed and milestone-tied.

Proposed next steps:
- Laura: pricing/legal check on option 2 language (credit + milestones)
- Monica: commercial impact (P&L) and whether a waiver skews runway for the quarter
- Aditya: quick thumbs by Mon EOD or earliest possible so I can revert to Emma on Tue.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min sync if helpful.

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
[attachment: proposed_accommodation_term_sheet.pdf (pdf)]

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch coverage accommodation request — BrightPath Q4 go-live

Thanks Karthik — reviewed option language. My quick read: option 2 (one-time credit) is cleaner from a billing/contract perspective and easier to tee up with finance. Suggested guardrails:

- Credit capped at $10k for a one-time Q4 invoice reduction.
- Credit conditional on them confirming a new go-live window by Nov 10 and providing a short success report at 30 days post-go-live.
- Include a clause that the credit is a one-off commercial concession and not a change to our public pricing or future entitlement.

Commercial impact: Monica, FYI the $10k cap reduces recognized revenue for Q4 but is manageable if we track as a one-time sales concession.

Karthik — if you can accept $10k + milestone language, I'll have legal draft the amending memo and we can loop in finance for approval quickly. If they push for more (e.g., 60-day waiver), we'll need an exec trade-off (revenue vs. strategic reference value).

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch coverage accommodation request — BrightPath Q4 go-live

Thanks for the summary. I approve the one-time commercial accommodation on the terms Laura outlined:
- $10,000 credit against the Q4 invoice
- BrightPath must confirm revised go-live by 2026-11-10 and provide a 30-day success report
- Concession documented as a non-precedential, timeboxed commercial exception

Karthik — please confirm with Emma today and share the legal memo once ready. Keep the ask narrowly scoped; if BrightPath pushes for a waiver instead, escalate back to me with a clear ROI/PR case.

Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
SVP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
